text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the north side of Deloraine Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the north side of Deloraine Avenue, between a point 20 metres west of Ridley Boulevard/Jedburgh Road and a point 5.5 metres further west.
